title: Kononenkogroup footer
description: A window-tall closing screen on black, on a 15-column grid: the three-line wordmark, then tiny serif labels with white grotesk link runs (navigation, elsewhere, studios, opening hours with grey times) across the top; giant grotesk letters stretched exactly edge to edge; and a row of tiny grey serif credits at the foot. On phones the groups fall into two columns. Lines rise from their masks; links underline on hover.
notes: always dark: its root carries the dark class, so it reads the theme's dark tokens even on a light page
the giant letters are an SVG text stretched to the full width (textLength), so any 3–5 letters fill it
four top groups and five credits fit the grid; more are dropped
